title: Can Circuit Alignment Predict OOD Generalization?
abstract: arXiv:2609.31996v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Can out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization be predicted from a trained model's weights alone, without any target-domain data? Existing representational similarity metrics (CKA, SVCCA, RSA) compare activations rather than forecast generalization. We show they are provably insensitive to structural rerouting in the computational graph, the very change distribution shift induces. We close this gap with the Circuit Alignment Score (CAS), which compares class-specific circuits across domains via graph kernels, decomposed into same-class coherence and cross-class confusion. Casting CAS as a Lebesgue integral over the domain distribution, we prove its Monte Carlo estimate recovers the ground-truth ranking of learners by OOD accuracy, with pairwise inversion error vanishing at rate $O(1/M)$, where $M$ is the number of sampled domains. Across $48$ learners on PACS, CAS attains $0.88$ rank correlation with OOD accuracy, versus $0.58$ (CKA),

translated_title: 电路对齐能否预测分布外泛化？
translated_abstract: 能否仅凭训练好的模型的权重来预测分布外泛化，而无需任何目标域数据？现有的表征相似性度量（CKA、SVCCA、RSA）比较的是激活值而非预测泛化能力。我们证明这些度量对计算图中的结构性重路由可证明地不敏感，而这种重路由恰恰是分布偏移所引起的变化。我们提出了电路对齐分数来填补这一空白，该分数通过图核比较跨域的类别特定电路，并将其分解为同类一致性和跨类混淆。将 CAS 视为域分布上的勒贝格积分，我们证明其蒙特卡洛估计能够按分布外准确率恢复学习器的真实排序，其成对反转误差以 $O(1/M)$ 的速率消失，其中 $M$ 是采样域的数量。在 PACS 数据集上的 48 个学习器实验中，CAS 与分布外准确率达到 0.88 的秩相关性，而 CKA 仅为 0.58。
tldr: 提出电路对齐分数（CAS），仅凭训练模型的权重即可预测分布外泛化性能，在 PACS 上达到 0.88 的秩相关，显著优于 CKA 等传统表征相似性度量。
en_tdlr: Proposes the Circuit Alignment Score (CAS), which predicts OOD generalization from model weights alone, achieving 0.88 rank correlation on PACS and significantly outperforming traditional representational similarity metrics such as CKA.
